name: Ren Kakyoku
source:
One of the six boys newly arrived in the town of Rosalind. He attends the same school as the protagonist and seems to be strangely interested in her/him/them.

He wears outfits stereotypical of online emos, yet his eloquence in speech sounds like that of a prim and proper prince. As if he is refined to the highest degree. Then, he looks quite discoordinated.

He plays the piano.
